scope: Three bytecode-reviewed LP raw mappings with ten fixed fields plus allowance and nonce roots. Full packaged emitted and holder audits remain separate gates; no global enumeration or all-future-path claim.

execution_contexts.scope: Observed execution path only; unexecuted branches and uninitialized holder state are not qualified

tokens.review_basis: Manually reviewed complete valid raw balanceOf path with one slot-1 mapping read and no metadata-dependent value branch. Exact runtime shared by these candidates. Ten fixed fields and allowance/nonce mappings independently traced and overridden; addresses mask low 160 bits, slot 8 packs uint112,uint112,uint32 and slot 12 guards mint entry with equality to one. Allowances use nested owner/spender mapping at root 2 and nonces use the address mapping at root 4. Verified source is not claimed. Other unknown writes remain errors.
